note.title: web crawling & js analysis
note.intro: descobrir todos os endpoints, arquivos js, parametros e rotas de api de uma aplicacao web. essencial pra achar endpoints escondidos, apis internas, e segredos vazados em javascript.
commands:
# wayback machine (archive.org)
curl -s "https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=*.alvo.com&output=text&fl=original&collapse=urlkey" | sort -u > wayback_urls.txt

# gau (getallurls — varias fontes)
gau alvo.com --o gau_urls.txt
gau --subs alvo.com --o gau_all.txt

# waybackurls
waybackurls alvo.com | sort -u > waybackurls.txt

# gospider (busca todas as fontes + crawl ativo)
gospider -s "https://alvo.com" -o gospider_out -t 20 -d 3 --js

# katana (projectdiscovery, muito rapido)
katana -u https://alvo.com -d 3 -jc -kf -o katana_urls.txt
katana -list live_subs.txt -d 2 -o katana_all.txt

# hakrawler
echo "https://alvo.com" | hakrawler -d 3 -subs

# juntar todas as fontes
(gau alvo.com; waybackurls alvo.com; katana -u https://alvo.com -d 2 -silent) | sort -u > all_urls.txt

# urls com parametros (potencial injecao)
cat all_urls.txt | grep "=" | qsreplace "FUZZ" | sort -u > params.txt

# endpoints de api
cat all_urls.txt | grep -iE "api|graphql|v1|v2|rest|json|xml|swagger|openapi" | sort -u > api_endpoints.txt

# arquivos js
cat all_urls.txt | grep -E "\.js$|\.js\?" | sort -u > js_files.txt

# arquivos sensiveis
cat all_urls.txt | grep -iE "\.env|\.config|\.json|\.yaml|\.bak|\.backup|\.old|\.sql|\.zip|\.tar" | sort -u > sensitive_files.txt

# rotas interessantes
cat all_urls.txt | grep -iE "admin|dashboard|panel|login|register|debug|test|staging|secret|internal|backup" | sort -u > interesting_routes.txt

# endpoints de upload/download
cat all_urls.txt | grep -iE "upload|download|file|export|import" | sort -u > file_endpoints.txt

# redirects (potencial ssrf / open redirect)
cat all_urls.txt | grep -iE "redirect|url=|next=|return=|callback=|target=" | sort -u > redirects.txt

# baixar todos os js
cat js_files.txt | getJS --complete --resolve --output js_downloads/

# subjs (extrai endpoints de js via regex)
cat js_files.txt | subjs -c 20 > js_endpoints.txt

# jsluice (go, secrets + urls de js)
jsluice urls js_downloads/*.js > jsluice_urls.txt
jsluice secrets js_downloads/*.js > jsluice_secrets.txt

# grep multi-padrao nos js baixados
grep -rnE "api[_-]?key|apikey|secret|token|password|passwd|private[_-]?key" js_downloads/

# aws keys
grep -rnE "AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}|aws_access|aws_secret|s3\.amazonaws" js_downloads/

# firebase configs (as vezes com chave de admin)
grep -rnE "firebase\.initializeApp|firebaseConfig|apiKey.*AIza" js_downloads/

# mapas de rota (react/vue/angular)
grep -rnE "path:|route:|Router|Routes|createRouter" js_downloads/ | head -30

# no console do devtools (F12 > Console):
# extrair urls do js carregado na pagina
performance.getEntriesByType('resource').filter(r => r.initiatorType === 'script').map(r => r.name)

# buscar variaveis globais expostas
Object.keys(window).sort()

# em Sources > Search (ctrl+shift+f) buscar por:
# apiKey, secret, token, password, aws_, firebase, mongodb, postgres, private_key, BEGIN RSA

# verificar source maps
cat all_urls.txt | grep "\.js\.map$" > sourcemaps.txt
while read url; do curl -s "$url" -o "js/$(basename $url)"; done < sourcemaps.txt

# whatweb
whatweb -a 3 https://alvo.com --no-errors

# wappalyzer cli
npx wappalyzer https://alvo.com

# webanalyze (go)
webanalyze -hosts live_subs.txt -output csv > tech_analysis.csv

#!/bin/bash DOMAIN=$1 OUTDIR="recon/$DOMAIN/crawl" mkdir -p "$OUTDIR" echo "[*] coletando urls historicas..." gau "$DOMAIN" --o "$OUTDIR/gau.txt" 2>/dev/null waybackurls "$DOMAIN" | sort -u > "$OUTDIR/wayback.txt" echo "[*] crawl ativo..." -f live_subs.txt && katana -list live_subs.txt -d 2 -silent -o "$OUTDIR/katana.txt" katana -u "https://$DOMAIN" -d 2 -silent -o "$OUTDIR/katana_root.txt" echo "[*] juntando e filtrando..." cat "$OUTDIR/gau.txt" "$OUTDIR/wayback.txt" "$OUTDIR/katana.txt" "$OUTDIR/katana_root.txt" 2>/dev/null | sort -u > "$OUTDIR/all_urls.txt" cat "$OUTDIR/all_urls.txt" | grep "=" | sort -u > "$OUTDIR/params.txt" cat "$OUTDIR/all_urls.txt" | grep -E "\.js$|\.js\?" | sort -u > "$OUTDIR/js_files.txt" cat "$OUTDIR/all_urls.txt" | grep -iE "api|graphql|v1|rest" | sort -u > "$OUTDIR/api.txt" echo "[*] baixando js e scan de secrets..." mkdir -p "$OUTDIR/js" cat "$OUTDIR/js_files.txt" | getJS --complete --resolve --output "$OUTDIR/js/" 2>/dev/null grep -rlnE "api[_-]?key|secret|token|password|aws_|firebase" "$OUTDIR/js/" > "$OUTDIR/js_secrets.txt" 2>/dev/null echo "[+] $(wc -l < "$OUTDIR/all_urls.txt") urls" echo "[+] $(wc -l < "$OUTDIR/params.txt") com parametros" echo "[+] $(wc -l < "$OUTDIR/js_files.txt") arquivos js" echo "[done] resultados em $OUTDIR/"

cat all_urls.txt | grep "\.js\.map$" > sourcemaps.txt
while read url; do curl -s "$url" -o "js/$(basename $url)"; done < sourcemaps.txt

# extrair arquivos do source map
npx source-map-explorer js/app.js.map
# ou
npx shuji js/app.js.map -o src_extracted/

mitmproxy2swagger -i flow.mitm -o spec.yaml -f har
# alternativa mais nova: mitm2openapi (Arkptz) em 2 passos
mitm2openapi discover -i flow.mitm -o endpoints.json
mitm2openapi generate -i endpoints.json -o spec.yaml

# APK
apktool d app.apk -o app_src
grep -rnE "https?://" app_src/ | grep -oE "https?://[a-zA-Z0-9./_:-]+" | sort -u > apk_urls.txt

# IPA (jadx pra decompilar .dex/.jar em Android; class-dump pra iOS)
jadx app.apk -d app_src
grep -rnE "https?://" app_src/ | grep -oE "https?://[a-zA-Z0-9./_:-]+" | sort -u

# google dorks
# site:postman.com intitle:"alvo"
# filetype:json postman intext:"alvo.com"
# site:getpostman.com "alvo.com"
# intext:"postman_collection" "alvo.com"
warnings: [!warning] katana sem -jc nao crawlea JS. sem essa flag perde endpoints escondidos em bundles webpack
paragraphs: descobrir todos os endpoints, arquivos js, parametros e rotas de api de uma aplicacao web. essencial pra achar endpoints escondidos, apis internas, e segredos vazados em javascript.
gau pega historico profundo, katana faz crawl ativo rapido, waybackurls pega archive.org. os tres juntos cobrem quase tudo.
[!warning] katana sem -jc nao crawlea JS. sem essa flag perde endpoints escondidos em bundles webpack
[!tip] gau com –subs em wildcard. sem isso perde ~60% das URLs de subdominios
baixar .js.map e extrair codigo fonte original. se o alvo tem webpack com devtool: source-map, voce baixa o fonte completo do projeto.
gerar OpenAPI spec do trafego do Burp/mitmproxy. a partir do trafego real, reconstruir a superficie da API.
extrair URLs de APK/IPA. mobile apps frequentemente hardcode endpoints internos que nao estao no web.
collections publicas podem expor endpoints, auth headers, e ambiente do alvo.
